log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

log_file.description: Path to log file; empty string logs to stderr.

bind_host.description: IP address the agent binds to (for general service endpoints).

bind_port.description: Port the agent listens on for incoming requests.

transport_url.description: Message broker connection string (e.g., RabbitMQ or ZeroMQ URL).

rate_limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per period (0 = unlimited).

agent_enabled.description: Whether the designate-agent service is enabled.

agent_bind_host.description: IP address the agent specifically binds to for DNS queries (e.g., for AXFR/notify).

agent_bind_port.description: DNS port the agent listens on (typically 53 for DNS service).

agent_region_name.description: OpenStack region name where the service resides.

agent_project_name.description: Project name used for Keystone authentication.

agent_password.description: Password for Keystone authentication (sensitive; set via secure secret in production).

upstream_dns_servers.description: List of upstream DNS servers (IP:port) to forward queries to when not serving local zones.

zonefile_dir.description: Directory to store zone files for AXFR responses.

agent_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the agent service.

agent_max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests the agent can handle.

lock_path.description: Directory to store lock files for concurrency control.

policy_file.description: Path to the JSON policy rules file.

policy_rules.description: Optional inline override for policy rules (raw JSON string). Use sparingly.
